questions.question_english: A teacher in an upper primary school physically strikes a student for failing to complete homework. The parents complain to the Principal. Under Section 17 of the RTE Act, what is the mandatory course of action for the Principal?

questions.explanation_english: Section 17 prohibits physical punishment and mental harassment of a child. The response must address the prohibited conduct and protect the child from recurrence.
